Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.

It’s that time of the month where we add a new update to Marvel Future Fight, and as Marvel’s Thor: Ragnarok has entered theatres worldwide, this update revolves around that. It’s time to take to the battlefield as Thor, Valkyrie and others in the all new Cinematic Battle! As well as new characters, new uniforms and a new mode, there are also modifications to the upgrade systems for cards and ISO-8’s and the all new Comic Card Collections!


■3 New Characters
Valkyrie, Scourge and Heimdall have been added to the game.




※Skill numbers and descriptions based on level 1
※Scourge and Heimdall can be obtained via biometric selectors.
※Valkyrie is available from the ‘Get 20 Biometrics daily’ package.

■4 New Uniforms

New Uniforms for Thor, Loki, Hulk and Hela have been added.



※The prices of the 3 new uniforms (Thor, Hulk, and Loki) are different compared to the existing uniforms already on sale. They also require more materials for the Uniform Upgrade, but the stats increased will be greater.
※New Uniforms will be available at a discounted price for a certain period
※New Uniforms can be tested in the Uniform Room


■Cinematic Battle

The all new Cinematic Battle has been released. This new mode will allow you to take control of some of the most iconic fights from the Marvel Universe! You will also have a chance to collect some new rewards which have been added to this mode.


-Cinematic Battle can be entered via the Challenge Menu.

Upon entering the Cinematic Battle mode, you will see the following screen showing all the relevant information.




1. Here you can check all the possible bonus rewards which are possible to get once.
2. Here you can see information about the stage and also your overall ranking compared to other players.  
3. Reward information is displayed here.
Rewards will depend on fulfilling the reward conditions.
4. Enter the stage.


Cinematic Battles will be played with the hero which is assigned to the stage. Even if you do not currently have a hero, you will be able to enter the stage.

Bonus rewards based on the level of your character and Uniform can only be acquired once.  
 



- A list of special rewards can be found in the ‘Bonus Reward’ section in the upper left of the screen.
※ Bonus Compensation will be awarded when the stage is cleared and the bonus condition has been completed.
※ Bonus rewards are only available once per account.



Once you enter the battle, you will be given a time limit to clear the stage.
. If all enemies have been defeated within the time limit, you will clear the stage

-Classic scenes from the Marvel Cinematic Universe are recreated in Marvel Future Fight’s Cinematic Battle Mode

When you clear the stage, you will see your score in the results window and you will be able to see all the rewards that you have earned.


※ The cinematic supply box will be sent to your mail.

 

■New Comic Card Collection function added

Collecting comic cards has never been more exciting with the all new comic card collection. Two new features have been added, the first is the Comic Card Collection and the second is the Comic Cards.
 


-You can see all the comic cards that are available in this screen.

Card Collection

New special collections have been added. These collections are sorted into themes, and collecting the cards shown will allow you to complete the set and unlock some additional bonuses. Cards will only be unlocked in the collection window if they are of Mythic Rank.

-If you collect a new card of a specific collection, you will be notified with a red dot and the card image will be illuminated.

※Only mythical comic cards can be registered to the card collection.
※Even if a comic card is consumed, once it has been registered it will stay active in the collection.
※Cards that have been used before the update will not be registered.


Cards

This page will allow you to see all the comic cards in Marvel Future Fight. Each card is shown in the list, and long pressing on the card will show where the card can be obtained.

New Cards added and Premium Card Borders.

New cards have been added to the game. Also premium cards will now have a new border to indicate that they are difficult to obtain.



■ISO-8 and Special Gear improvements

We have improved the functionality of ISO-8’s and Special gears to make them easier to sort and easier to upgrade. We have also added a few new special gears, called Celestial Tech Packs (CTP) to the game.

ISO-8 + Special Gear Enhancement Improvements

We have improved the process of enhancing ISO-8’s and Special Gears. You can now select up to 10 upgrade materials for them to be upgraded.


ISO-8 Quick Enhancement Improvements

Quick Enhancements for ISO-8 has also been improved to make it easier to use. You can now select the grades and types of ISO-8 you wish to use as materials to improve your ISO-8.


Locked ISO-8 Improvement
If you upgrade a locked ISO-8, the resulting ISO-8 will be automatically locked. It doesn’t matter if the other ISO-8 was locked, if the 1st ISO-8 is locked, the result will also be locked. 

The inventory will now also check the amount of progress that the equipment has and sort accordingly.

Celestial Tech Packs [C.T.P.]
A new breed of special gears have been discovered. The Celestial Tech Packs [C.T.P.] contain some different stats and can be obtained with a low probability through Hidden Routes. They can also be earned through Boost Point rewards and also in Special Gear chests.




■ Other Changes

1. The size of the damage indicators and display speed has been modified.
2. Battle UI has been improved to show certain heroes unique buff effects.
3. Improved the UI when using clear tickets on the Rise of the X-Men epic quest: Veiled Secret. If an item has a limited quantity, the announcement will only popup once.
4. For items in the store which can only be purchased a limited number of times per day, if you have exhausted the number of purchases the buy button will fade more.
5. Fixed an issue in Alliance Conquest where the leadership of team one would apply to the 2nd team.
6. Fixed an issue where the previous team effects were displayed for the current team in World Boss Invasion.
7. For 'Wolverine - Age of Apocalypse' uniform, all attacks / all defenses of will be increased.
8. Fixed the following issues from the September update:
-If all quest packs have been completed in special missions, a pop-up saying that there are no quest packs available will no longer show.
- The red dot will no longer show for energy recharge if the energy has already been claimed.
- Fixed a game crash issue with Scarlet Witch's World Boss stage.
- When viewing other player’s teams, Equipped URU will now show correctly.
- Fixed an issue with the game restarting if changing teams in the Dimension Rift Windows.
- Fixed an issue where it was possible to have 3 of the same character on a team (although you could not start a stage with it)
9. Fixed an issue where ‘Destroyer’ would not move after his skill ‘Crush’ was activated.
10. Character 3D models have been improved:
- Hulk: The Avengers (Basic) / Secret Wars: Future Imperfect / World War Hulk
- Mockingbird: Heroic Age (Basic) / Marvel's Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D
- Loki: The Avengers (Basic)
- Doctor Strange: Marvel's Doctor Strange
